mission_04: Congratulations on building a complete GCN node classifier! You have implemented the full training pipeline: forward propagation through two graph convolution layers, softmax probability computation, masked cross-entropy loss, and analytical backpropagation. The masking technique you used is essential for semi-supervised learning on graphs, where only a small fraction of nodes have labels. This is the same approach used in the original GCN paper on the Cora, Citeseer, and Pubmed citation networks. You now have the skills to classify nodes in any graph-structured dataset.
